description: This file provides PHP API functions for interacting with the CCSP Data Model, including retrieving and setting parameter values, managing object instances, and deleting objects. It acts as a wrapper around lower-level extension APIs.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values under a specified root object by calling the extension API.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a specified root object by calling the extension API.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs under a specified object table.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified object table.

methods.name: DmDelObj
methods.description: Deletes an object instance specified by its name.
